parsed.why: No criminalisation, no facility bans, hospital and prison placement by affirmed gender, strong acceptance climate; but documented police mistreatment of visibly trans people, no national anti-discrimination law, hate-crime aggravator unapplied, contested 2025 rollback.

Federal entry screening refuses marker mismatches, confiscated passports, visa fraud ineligibility; criminal facility bans with a documented arrest and men's-ward detention; custody care denial; allied advisories. Protective states and courts only partly offset.

No criminalisation or border friction; goods-and-services anti-discrimination covering change of sex; hate-crime aggravator; custody placement by disclosed identity with no birth-sex rule. Negatives are thin enforcement data and resident-only gaps.

Contested ten-year sodomy ordinance, morality provisions reaching trans people, documented police torture and extortion of gay residents, banned organising, no recognition or recourse, family and social persecution, collapsed HIV care. Thin but structurally adverse.

Enforced statute: up to eight years plus lashes, same-sex marriage criminalised, no trans-specific rule, recognition or protection; one 2015 arrest, stabbing of a blogger, resort-bubble tolerance ungrounded in law, undocumented trans classification.
